# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We release patches for security vulnerabilities for the latest major version.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.1.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within `wp-react`, please **do not open a public GitHub issue**. 

Instead, please report it by emailing **[CivilForYou (at) yahoo.com]** (replace with your actual email) or by using the "Report a vulnerability" button on the GitHub Security tab.

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and provide a detailed timeline for the fix. We appreciate your efforts in keeping `wp-react` secure!
